newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 7.973 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 7.973 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Sunday that cotton output from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop had reached a provisional 7.973 million 375-lb bales by January 23, down from 8.717 million bales in the same period last year.
It said mills had bought 6.005 million bales, down from 6.166 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had picked up only 2,700 bales against 858,100 bales last year.
A total of 1.964 million unsold bales were stocked at ginning factories, compared to 1.693 million bales in the year-ago period, the corporation said.

Officials say the 1996/97 crop, damaged by pests in the main Punjab province cotton belt, will approach nine million bales, below earlier forecasts of 10 million bales. Last year's production totalled 9.96 million bales.
